media.alt: Adult woman in streetwear surrounded by pop-art burger, fries, and drink illustrations.

method: Keep the seated pose, urban perspective, and photo-to-illustration contrast while adapting the meal, palette, and fictional graphic marks.

variants.label: Streetwear portrait with fast-food stickers
variants.promptText:
A young woman with shoulder-length dark brown wavy hair sitting cross-legged
on a wooden bench/stool, eating a cartoon-style burger with her right hand
raised to her mouth. She wears round gold-framed reflective sunglasses, a
white oversized graphic t-shirt featuring a cartoon illustration print on the
chest, baggy distressed teal/denim wide-leg pants with ripped knees, and
chunky platform sandals — left foot in blue and red sandal, right foot in
red sandal with visible red-painted toenails. She holds a red cartoon soda
cup with a red straw in her left hand. Surrounding her are floating
comic-style fast food elements: an animated crying cheeseburger bottom-left,
a cartoon french fries box top-left dripping red sauce with hearts, and a
cartoon soda cup. The background is a real photographic urban outdoor setting
with glass storefront, trees, cloudy blue sky, and tiled floor. The art style
blends realistic photography with vibrant 2D cartoon/comic illustration
overlays on the food items and clothing. Small white sparkle/star doodles
scattered across the frame. Bright, high saturation colors, fun and playful
pop-art street style mood.

purpose: Frame a photographic subject with energetic 2D food graphics while preserving pose and clothing readability.
summary: A photoreal urban portrait combines oversized streetwear with bright comic-style burgers, fries, drinks, and sparkle overlays.
title: Pop-Art Fast-Food Streetwear Portrait
